name: Kirloskar Brothers Ltd
title: Kirloskar Brothers Ltd-$ - 500241 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 consolidated revenue up 10% to Rs14.15bn but FY26 flat at Rs45.38bn; UK SPP margin mix hit EBITDA, while domestic order book up 30% to Rs24.68bn with no numeric FY27 guidance.

triggers.label: Domestic order book +30% to Rs24.68bn
triggers.quote: our domestic order book stands at Rs.24.680 billion, registering a robust growth of 30% over the previous year
triggers.highlight: domestic order book stands at Rs.24.680 billion

triggers.label: Price rises passed through
triggers.quote: we are able to pass on price rises whenever required
triggers.highlight: we are able to pass on price rises

triggers.label: SPP UK EBITDA Rs95cr to Rs58.1cr
triggers.quote: SPP U.K., which moved from Rs.95 crores to Rs.58.1 crores, Rs.37 crores drop in EBITDA
triggers.highlight: moved from Rs.95 crores to Rs.58.1 crores

triggers.label: Double-digit growth 'strive' for FY27
triggers.quote: we'll strive for double -digit growth this year as well

guidance.quote: we'll strive for double -digit growth this year as well

guidance.value: return to FY25 levels, likely by around calendar Q3
guidance.quote: we would probably look to get back to the margin levels that we're looking for even on a whole year basis

prior_guidance_check.quote: Unfortunately, last year, with all its challenges, we could not do that.

red_flags.label: Labour code one-off and ERP/foundry disruption hit FY26
red_flags.quote: we had SAP -based ERP implementation at the foundry operations in Kirloskarvadi

red_flags.label: UK service mix shift dragging margins
red_flags.quote: The service business has reduced. The product business has increased.

evasions.topic: Order book breakup by segment (SPP US liquid cooling)
evasions.quote: I don't know if we break the orderbook like this.

evasions.topic: JJM outstanding funds at country level
evasions.quote: I think the ministry would be the best people to ask such a question

evasions.topic: Aftersales share of domestic order book
